📖 Game script

San Francisco is without Nick Bosa and Mykel Williams (both out), with Mike Evans questionable. Brock Purdy (234+) leans on Christian McCaffrey: 66+ rushing, −245 to score, and Warren Sharp and PropStarz both take his receiving over because Denver blitzes at one of the highest early-down rates and Purdy checks down against it. George Kittle (65+) adds to that. Denver: Bo Nix (223+), J.K. Dobbins (60+, +118 to score), Courtland Sutton (Gilles Gallant, +240 to score) and Jaylen Waddle (57+) on a MEDIUM grade. It's about 90°F at kickoff. The 49ers score 32.7 a game at 7.3 yards per play, so this is close. San Francisco by one: Denver covers +2.5, and 47 points goes under 48.

🧠 Why the card leans this way

This is the most one-sided expert game on the slate. DEN: Action Network, Sharp or Square, Steve Fezzik, BettingPros, Chad Millman (his "trade of the week," calling the reverse line move sharp), John Jastremski, Evan Abrams, Matt Moore, Andrew Erickson (+3) and Dave Tuley of VSiN (+8.5 in teasers, a best bet). SF: Mike Florio (49ers 24–20) and Steve Makinen of VSiN (−3, a best bet). Splits: SF has 60% of spread tickets and 64% of the money and 84% of moneyline tickets, yet the line came down from the Action Network open of SF −3 to −2.5. Every DEN +3 position is now +2.5, past the key number. The lean is DEN +2.5 or the +126 moneyline, plus McCaffrey receiving. On the total, 60% of the money is on the under against 52% of tickets, and the total is up from 45.5 to 48; small under lean. Card: the heaviest exposure on the card (about $85). The DEN moneyline is in the Slot 2 Dog-ML 2-team RR, the Slot 4 Afternoon parlay and the Slot 5 Hybrid; DEN +2.5 is a proposed SuperContest pick (both SuperContest tickets); DEN +8.5 is a leg of the 6-pt Wong teaser JAX-DEN-ATL. A 49ers win by 3 or more hurts six tickets at once.

⚠️ What breaks it

The 49ers' offense, at 63% on third down, doesn't need Bosa to win a shootout: Kittle and McCaffrey beat the blitz and San Francisco wins by ten. Denver scores only 20 a game and can't keep pace if Nix is pressured. Mike Evans is a game-time decision with a rib injury (ESPN); recheck at the 11:55 PT inactive window.

🎙️ What the experts are saying

Action Network, Sharp or Square, Steve Fezzik and BettingPros: DEN +3, against "a heavily banged-up 49ers team" that is "inflated by public perception." Those +3 numbers are half a point better than the current +2.5.

John Jastremski: DEN +2.5: "the 49ers' injury report is massive." Evan Abrams: takes "the great defense with Denver." Matt Moore: DEN +2.5, contest pick.

Props. Warren Sharp, on a best-bets show, and PropStarz have McCaffrey over 37.5 and 39.5 receiving. Gilles Gallant has Courtland Sutton to score at +240 and Luke Farrell at +1100. @xEP_Network has Purdy over 229.5. Trent Conner (BettingPros) has Purdy as the first touchdown scorer at +1800.
